name: notepad_write
description: Write a finding to your working notepad so it survives beyond this reply. Use it as you read, not at the end: notes persist across turns, so a long qualitative pass over many documents can continue later. Appends by default.

note.description: the finding, in markdown; cite the doc_id it came from

section.description: which section to file it under, e.g. a topic or a doc_id

mode.description: 'replace' overwrites the section — use it to consolidate

notepad.description: notepad name; use one name for one piece of work
